step_event_ok_def
⊢ ∀mc ms s.
    step_event_ok mc ms s ⇔
    mc.target.get_pc ms ∈ mc.prog_addresses DIFF set mc.ffi_entry_pcs ∧
    encoded_bytes_in_mem mc.target.config (mc.target.get_pc ms)
      (mc.target.get_byte ms) mc.prog_addresses ∧
    EVERY mc.target.state_ok [ms; mc.target.next ms; s] ∧
    ∀x. x ∉ mc.prog_addresses ⇒
        mc.target.get_byte (mc.target.next ms) x = mc.target.get_byte ms x
statements.DEFINITION@50:
ffi_event_ok_def
⊢ ∀mc st ms i nb.
    ffi_event_ok mc st ms i nb ⇔
    MEM (mc.target.get_pc ms) mc.ffi_entry_pcs ∧
    mc.target.get_pc ms ≠ mc.halt_pc ∧ mc.target.get_pc ms ≠ mc.install_pc ∧
    find_index (mc.target.get_pc ms) mc.ffi_entry_pcs 0 = SOME i ∧
    ALOOKUP mc.mmio_info i = NONE ∧
    ∃nm b1 b2 st1.
      mc.ffi_names❲i❳ = ExtCall nm ∧
      read_ffi_bytearrays mc ms = (SOME b1,SOME b2) ∧
      call_FFI st (ExtCall nm) b1 b2 = FFI_return st1 nb
statements.DEFINITION@66:
ffi_post_st_def
⊢ ∀mc st ms i.
    ffi_post_st mc st ms i =
    case read_ffi_bytearrays mc ms of
      (NONE,v3) => st
    | (SOME b1,NONE) => st
    | (SOME b1,SOME b2) =>
      case call_FFI st mc.ffi_names❲i❳ b1 b2 of
        FFI_return st1 nb => st1
      | FFI_final e => st
statements.DEFINITION@81:
ffi_call_event_def
⊢ ∀mc ms i nb.
    ffi_call_event mc ms i nb =
    case read_ffi_bytearrays mc ms of
      (NONE,v3) => []
    | (SOME b1,NONE) => []
    | (SOME b1,SOME b2) =>
      if mc.ffi_names❲i❳ = ExtCall «» then []
      else [IO_event mc.ffi_names❲i❳ b1 (ZIP (b2,nb))]
statements.DEFINITION@93:
trace_next_interfer_def
⊢ (∀ms1 m P. trace_next_interfer P [] m ms1 = ms1) ∧
  (∀tr s ms1 m P.
     trace_next_interfer P (TrStep s::tr) m ms1 =
     if m = 0 then if P ms1 = P s then s else ms1
     else trace_next_interfer P tr (m − 1) ms1) ∧
  ∀tr s nb ms1 m i P.
    trace_next_interfer P (TrFfi i nb s::tr) m ms1 =
    trace_next_interfer P tr m ms1
statements.DEFINITION@104:
trace_ffi_interfer_def
⊢ (∀x ms0 k g G. trace_ffi_interfer G g ms0 [] k x = g k x) ∧
  (∀x tr s ms0 k g G.
     trace_ffi_interfer G g ms0 (TrStep s::tr) k x =
     trace_ffi_interfer G g s tr k x) ∧
  ∀x tr s nb ms0 k i g G.
    trace_ffi_interfer G g ms0 (TrFfi i nb s::tr) k x =
    if k = 0 then if x = (i,nb,ms0) ∧ G x s then s else g 0 x
    else trace_ffi_interfer G (shift_seq 1 g) s tr (k − 1) x
statements.DEFINITION@115:
nffis_def
⊢ nffis [] = 0 ∧ (∀tr s. nffis (TrStep s::tr) = nffis tr) ∧
  ∀tr s nb i. nffis (TrFfi i nb s::tr) = nffis tr + 1
statements.DEFINITION@120:
trace_last_def
⊢ (∀ms. trace_last ms [] = ms) ∧
  (∀tr s ms. trace_last ms (TrStep s::tr) = trace_last s tr) ∧
  ∀tr s nb ms i. trace_last ms (TrFfi i nb s::tr) = trace_last s tr
statements.DEFINITION@126:
trace_st_def
⊢ (∀st ms mc. trace_st mc st ms [] = st) ∧
  (∀tr st s ms mc. trace_st mc st ms (TrStep s::tr) = trace_st mc st s tr) ∧
  ∀tr st s nb ms mc i.
    trace_st mc st ms (TrFfi i nb s::tr) =
    trace_st mc (ffi_post_st mc st ms i) s tr
statements.DEFINITION@134:
trace_events_def
⊢ (∀ms mc. trace_events mc ms [] = []) ∧
  (∀tr s ms mc. trace_events mc ms (TrStep s::tr) = trace_events mc s tr) ∧
  ∀tr s nb ms mc i.
    trace_events mc ms (TrFfi i nb s::tr) =
    ffi_call_event mc ms i nb ++ trace_events mc s tr
statements.DEFINITION@142:
trace_ok_def
⊢ (∀st ms mc P G. trace_ok P G mc st ms [] ⇔ T) ∧
  (∀tr st s ms mc P G.
     trace_ok P G mc st ms (TrStep s::tr) ⇔
     step_event_ok mc ms s ∧ P (mc.target.next ms) = P s ∧
     trace_ok P G mc st s tr) ∧
  ∀tr st s nb ms mc i P G.
    trace_ok P G mc st ms (TrFfi i nb s::tr) ⇔
    ffi_event_ok mc st ms i nb ∧ G (i,nb,ms) s ∧
    trace_ok P G mc (ffi_post_st mc st ms i) s tr
